results.content:
Title: CapyCursor: Cursor highlight, screen draw, zoom & spotlight | Product Hunt
## Cursor highlight, screen draw, zoom & spotlight. CapyCursor is a lightweight Windows tool that makes on-screen presentations clearer and more engaging. Teachers, YouTubers, and meeting presenters can use it to highlight the cursor, draw directly on the screen, spotlight specific areas, zoom in on details, and switch to a blank whiteboard — all with a single hotkey. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for CapyCursor. CapyCursor started from a simple frustration: during presentations, recordings, or even daily work, it’s surprisingly hard to make your screen interactions clear and engaging. So we built CapyCursor to help you present, explain, and highlight better on screen, with features like: 🎨 Cursor skins (make your cursor actually visible & fun) 🖊️ Screen annotation & drawing 🔍 Spotlight & magnifier for focus 🧑‍🏫 Perfect for creators, teachers, and streamers We tried to keep it lightweight, simple, and actually useful in real scenarios—not just another flashy tool. IT is so refreshing to see new products that dont involve AI and are actually useful for our day to day. I downloaded capy cursor and loved how easy it is to install, how little time it takes and also how user friendly it is. I think is great that you have options for free features which are very useful for presentations. 🦫 Thank you so much for your sweet comment—we're over the moon that you love Capy Cursor! It makes us so happy to hear it's easy to use and helpful for your presentations. @capycursor i think this could be a great tool for senior citizens or children that are unable to read small text, so another feedback i have is to have the option to make the capybara button bigger, so they are able to reach it . Thanks a lot for the great feedback and the suggestion—this accessibility improvement is super helpful! Quick question to clarify: when you say you want the capybara button to be bigger, are you talking about the button in the settings, or the on-screen toolbar button? The ability to draw directly on screen is super useful. @elena\_nimchenko The screen drawing tool in Capycursor lets you draw, annotate, and highlight directly on your screen at any time.
